title: Why She Takes the Ferry
transcript: At the ferry terminal, I spoke with Alice Moore, who works at an office across the river. I asked why she had stopped driving to work. 'Parking was getting expensive,' she said. 'And I can read on the ferry, even if it takes a little longer.' I asked what she would change about the service. 'The last ferry leaves before I finish work on Fridays,' she told me. 'I have to take the bus home that day.'

questions.prompt: What made Alice stop driving to work?
options: Traffic getting worse on the bridge.
A change in her work location.
The high cost of repairing her car.
questions.explanation: 她提到停车费用越来越高。

questions.prompt: How does Alice get home on Fridays?
questions.explanation: 周五下班前末班渡轮已经开走，因此她坐公交车回家。
